subject.title: fix(teams-meetings): join and transcribe live meetings reliably

question: Should `meeting-runtime` keep a backwards-compatible permission-plan input for existing external plugins, or is this intentionally a breaking SDK contract change with a documented migration and release plan?
rationale: The diff changes a documented public plugin SDK callback from one required input shape to another; repository policy requires explicit compatibility/deprecation treatment for shipped external SDK APIs, and the permanent contract direction is a maintainer decision.

options.title: Add compatibility adapter
options.body: Keep the existing callback usable and introduce URL-aware permissions through an additive or optional API, then migrate bundled plugins.

options.title: Approve a breaking SDK change
options.body: Accept the required URL parameter only with an explicit migration/deprecation plan, compatibility documentation, and release-owner approval.

recommendation.title: Add compatibility adapter
recommendation.body: Keep the existing callback usable and introduce URL-aware permissions through an additive or optional API, then migrate bundled plugins.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the Teams adapter and authored the current shared meeting-runtime API change.
